#### Docker

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "memory": {
      "command": "docker",
      "args": ["run", "-i", "-v", "claude-memory:/app/dist", "--rm", "mcp/memory"]
    }
  }
}
```

#### NPX

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "memory": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

#### NPX on Windows

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "memory": {
      "command": "cmd",
      "args": ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"]
    }
  }
}
```

#### VS Code

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "servers": {
      "memory": {
        "command": "npx",
        "args": [
          "-y",
          "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
```
